newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: ITALY, CZECH REP APPLAUD NEWS OF YELTSIN OPERATION.
newsitem.headline: ITALY, CZECH REP APPLAUD NEWS OF YELTSIN OPERATION.

text.p: Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi applauded early reports from Russia on Tuesday that President Boris Yeltsin's heart operation had been a success and that the 65-year-old Yeltsin was fine.
"I'm very pleased, it's very good news...I can only wish that (Yeltsin's) convalescence is a short as possible," Prodi told reporters in Prague on a one-day visit to the Czech Republic.

Earlier Kremlin spokesman Sergei Yastrzhembsky told Russian news agencies that the multiple bypass operation, which Yeltsin hopes can give him strength to end months of political in-fighting, "ended successfully at 2 p.m.".
Prodi was joined by Czech Foreign Minister Josef Zieleniec who said that the successful completion of Yeltsin's operation was good news for the whole of Europe.

"The stability of Russia is one of the key factors for the stability of Europe and the world...and the recovery of Mr Yeltsin will contribute to the stabilisation of the situation in Russia," said Zieleniec.
According to a source in the Cardiology Research Centre, where the operation was carried out, surgery had gone well.
"Everything was fine, great," the source said. Asked about Yeltsin's condition after the bypass surgery, he replied,"He is OK."
